# Metric names that the Ingot image exports and that the alert rules and dashboards may query.
# The ingot_* names are registered by the bundled prometheus plugin (reposilite-plugins/prometheus-plugin), the
# jvm_* names by the JVM instrumentation that the plugin registers with JvmMetrics. A series with a _bucket, _sum or
# _count suffix counts as its family name. Lines starting with # are comments.
# up is generated by Prometheus when it scrapes a target, the image does not export it.
up
ingot_http_server_requests_total
ingot_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket
ingot_http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum
ingot_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count
ingot_deploy_results_total
ingot_upstream_requests_total
ingot_mirror_cache_entries
ingot_cluster_connected
ingot_cluster_dropped_events_total
ingot_batch_job_last_success_timestamp_seconds
ingot_search_outbox_pending
ingot_search_outbox_oldest_age_seconds
jvm_memory_used_bytes
jvm_memory_max_bytes
jvm_memory_committed_bytes
jvm_threads_current
jvm_gc_collection_seconds_count
jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum
